about: Cases for the Zen widget library licence-banner rule (scripts/zen-lib/banners.mjs). Every port of the rule must give `pass` for each case: scripts/zen-lib/check-banners.mjs --self-test and the partner build's licence-allow.py read this file. A case's input is `text`, with `{{pad}}` replaced by `pad.unit` repeated `pad.times` times when `pad` is given. `id` is the zen-lib.json id, `licence` the row's SPDX expression. Byte offsets are UTF-8. The rule is ASCII only: whitespace between comments is space, \t, \n, \v, \f, \r; a byte-order mark only at offset 0; word characters are [A-Za-z0-9_]; case folds only A-Z to a-z; a line comment ends at \n only. Non-ASCII is written as \u escapes.
